errors.text_span: според легендата съответства на твърдението, че само
errors.evidence: The machine-generated description incorrectly states that the green sector corresponds to 'само', while the legend indicates it represents 'Няма достатъчно подготвени и квалифицирани специалисти за изграждането на сграда според стандарта Пасивна къща.'

The machine-generated description does not explicitly state that the chart represents data about the level of preparation and qualification of contractors and designers for Passive House standard projects.
The machine-generated description does not mention the colors of the other sectors (blue, red, purple) or their corresponding percentages and labels as described in the reference.
The machine-generated description does not mention that the sectors are not ordered in any noticeable sequence, which is highlighted in the reference.
